summary: Tested persona generator feature end-to-end. 8/8 backend pytest cases passed (schema, disability constraints, frustration distribution, tolerance rules, count=3, invalid count 422, health). Frontend E2E flow passed: /generate-panel loads, nav has Generate between Persona Panels and Reports, audience input + count select + generate btn work, LLM call returns 4 persona cards in ~10s, cards show name/traits/disability badge, expand reveals editable fields, action toggles have visible on/off state, panel saves to /api/persona-panels and navigates to list where new panel is visible.
critical_code_review_comments: GeneratePanel.jsx uses raw axios with process.env directly instead of the shared api client from lib/api.js (generatePersonas helper is defined but unused) — minor DRY issue.
generator.py accent_color validation is missing in _validate_persona (only assigned if empty). Consider validating hex format.
Chevron expand button has no data-testid — tests must rely on DOM structure to expand cards.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 persona panel 'test-panel-<ts>' during E2E flow (safe to leave; prefixed for identification).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Persona generator LLM endpoint consumes credits (~10s per call). Test file uses 2 real LLM calls (module-scoped fixture + count=3). Frontend flow tested with 1 real LLM call. Reuse module fixture pattern to conserve credits.
